title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2600 Wesley Street in Greenville, Texas, as the "Audie Murphy Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2600 Wesley Street in Greenville, Texas, as the "Audie Murphy Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a Greenville, Texas post office building after World War II hero Audie Murphy.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2600 Wesley Street in Greenville, Texas, as the "Audie Murphy Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 30, 2020, and the naming applies from that date.
